answer: A new agent must lease one authenticated phone-number range for 12 epochs and receive four unpredictable voice callbacks per epoch. The carrier signs number, key, timestamp, and a short spoken nonce; validators verify the signature and compare acoustic and routing fingerprints. An ivory token may cross an island of pigment, but every extra fake needs another live line and 48 callbacks, so 1,000 clones require 1,000 lines and 48,000 timely calls. Shared fingerprints merge rewards; two missed calls suspend the cluster for six epochs.
